name: NEO ORDER_FLOW_ADAPTIVE_LEARNING: tiered high-frequency PAPER entries with size/avoid learning, on the durable honest PAPER runtime
policy: Owner-requested on 2026-10-08: trade as often as honest costs allow, learn from closed trades and lean toward what has been profitable. PAPER only; existing history, balance, trade sequence and audit are preserved; no reset, no live execution, no automatic live-money promotion.
integrity_note: Primary learner keeps the same CORE/EXPLORE entry thresholds, scoring, sizing and learning. Owner-requested exit change: new PAPER positions use fixed executable-net SL -4% and TP +10% via HONEST_NET_EXIT_V1. Existing positions keep their recorded exit rules. Verified flow coverage, exact pool/mint checks, safety checks, bounded quote age and uncapped modeled gap losses remain mandatory. Current live-tape mints are pinned into each rotating scan and use the exact taped pool so verified flow can overlap entry evaluation; entry thresholds are unchanged. Transient DexScreener and Solana RPC transport failures now retry/fail over without changing any entry, risk, quote, sizing or exit threshold; incomplete per-pair flow still fails closed.
runtime_note: Primary PAPER engine holds up to eight liquidity-scaled positions across CORE and EXPLORE tiers. Positions opened under an earlier profile keep the stop and exit policy recorded at entry.
stop_execution_note: Planned net stop -4%; take profit +10% net. Observed gap losses and unavailable liquidation risk are retained; the stop is not a guaranteed fill.

discovery.continuous_rotation: Every market scan prioritizes genuinely new/newborn pools, then rotates the persistent universe; repeated provider snapshots are not re-prioritized.

Adds DexScreener recent profile updates to discovery telemetry. 2026-10-10: DexScreener discovery defensively skips non-object rows so malformed provider items cannot halt the scan; strategy filters and execution logic are unchanged. 2026-10-10: token-market refresh drops non-object provider rows before pair selection so one malformed DexScreener item cannot stop the continuous scan; no strategy threshold, sizing or exit behavior changed. 2026-10-10: direct-latest tape-pin filtering preserves the mint-to-pool mapping used by exact-pool preference; fixes discovery-only type regression without changing entry or exit rules. 2026-10-10: dashboard-only wallet/holder reads now execute independent RPC/Gecko lookups concurrently and skip slow holder entry-history enrichment on the first paint; trading signals, safety gates, sizing, quotes and exits are unchanged. 2026-10-10: holder RPC refresh is stale-while-revalidate so a slow or rate-limited top-holder provider can never delay the buyer/seller HTTP response; cached holder rows populate on subsequent fast polls.
